description: 4 should-trigger + 4 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers mapping content shapes onto funnel stages, a leaking stage with no asset that would catch it, re-mapping after an ICP change, and a German phrasing that never names a funnel. Should-not covers the three neighbours the skill's own routing names (cadence, quantitative drop-off, drafting the asset) plus one unrelated counterexample.

queries.q: which content shape belongs at each funnel stage for our mid-market buyer
consideration is leaking and we have no asset that would catch anyone there
we changed ICP — remap our content shapes per stage, the old mapping was inherited
ordne unsere Inhalte den Phasen zu, im Moment schreibt jeder was er mag
what should our publishing cadence be — weekly or twice a month
queries.note: cadence is editorial-calendar, not stage-to-shape mapping

queries.q: why did signup-to-activation drop 12 points last month
write the comparison page we agreed belongs at the decision stage
queries.note: drafting the asset is downstream of this skill

queries.q: our nightly backup job has been failing silently for a week
